title: Enterprise attack-surface analysis (verifier-grounded)
purpose: hard, machine-checked security-analyst questions over large, realistic multi-tier enterprise attack graphs (perimeter → foothold → credential → auth → lateral → privilege escalation → collection → crown-jewel data; ~30-40 nodes, conjunctive controls as AND-joins, broad attack surface). Ground truth is the Z3 verifier / model semantics.
